description: This file defines a MetricsClient class for interacting with a metrics API endpoint, including functions to resolve base URLs, join URLs, and fetch current metrics with support for conditional GET requests using ETag and Last-Modified headers.

classes.name: MetricsClient
classes.description: A lightweight API client for fetching metrics data from the backend service.

methods.name: resolveApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL from environment variables, prioritizing REACT_APP_API_BASE, then REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, and defaulting to an empty string.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL and a path segment safely, handling relative paths and trailing slashes.

methods.name: fetchCurrentMetrics
methods.description: Fetches the current metrics snapshot from the API, supporting conditional GET with ETag and Last-Modified headers, and handles response parsing and errors.
